other_failure_modes.name: In-fold target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates target means on the entire training set and applies these values directly back onto the training data. This causes target leakage within the training set, which can lead models (especially tree-based ones) to overfit the encoded features. A more robust approach would use out-of-fold (K-fold) target encoding.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation set reuse for early stopping and ensembling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the same validation set to trigger early stopping during base model training and to optimize the SLSQP ensemble weights. This double-dipping leaks information from the validation set into both the model weights and the ensemble blend, resulting in an overly optimistic final validation score.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution overall, correctly handling chronological splitting, extensive feature engineering, and robust neural network regularisation. However, it suffers from a few moderate flaws, including in-fold target encoding that risks training leakage, reusing the validation set for both early stopping and ensemble weight optimisation, and failing to evaluate stochastic models across multiple random seeds.
